title: Tughlaq dynasty: more reforms, people and Andhra

boxes.title: Ghiyasuddin: added detail
items: Son of a Turkish slave + a **Jat** woman; killed **Khusrau Shah** → throne **1320**
Took back unlawful grants; remission in drought; waste land ploughed
Postal system: runners + horsemen
**1321-22**: Prince **Juna Khan** (later MBT) retreats on false news of Sultan's death
Warangal fell after a ==**5-month** siege== (**1323**)
Strained relations with **Nizamuddin Auliya**; **Ibn Battuta** suspects Juna Khan's plot

boxes.title: MBT: more points
items: Daulatabad shift: **1327**, central base for the Deccan
Token coins c. **1329-30**: cause = ==silver shortage==
Doab famine: relief camp ==**Swargadwari**== on the Ganga near **Kannauj**
**Taqavi** (sondhar): loans for seed + wells
**Uluq** every **4** miles; **dawa**: three stations to every mile
Ibn Battuta: spy system; **sati** needed Sultan's permission
**Badauni**: on MBT's death at **Thatta** (**1351**), Sultan freed from his people and they from him

cards.title: Firoz: origin
lines: Maqbul paid compensation to MBT's victims

cards.title: Firoz: revenue
lines: Kept **four** Sharia taxes: kharaj, jizya, khams, zakat

boxes.title: Firoz: books & campaigns
items: **Jawalamukhi** library: about **1,300** Sanskrit manuscripts → Persian by **Azizuddin Khan**
**Ragadarpan**: music text translated
**Barani**: Tarikh-i-Firoz Shahi, ==Fatawa-i-Jahandari==
**Bengal**: two failed campaigns vs **Haji Iliyas** (second **1359-60**)
Took **Jajnagar** + **Nagarkot**; Sind: **Jam Babaniya** paid tribute

items.what: Ghiyasuddin II, **Abu Bakr**, Nasiruddin Muhammad Shah fight each other

boxes.title: More exam points
items: Vijayanagara: **Harihara and Bukka** sent by MBT; guide **Vidyaranya**
**Siri** = Alauddin; **Tughlaqabad** = Ghiyasuddin
Firoz's hereditary iqtas + slave corps weakened central control
